notes.title: Christmas Update!
notes.notes:
Ho ho ho! We are here with an AMAZING Christmas update! 

New Class!: Santa class!
With new weapons!
The Christmas bell - Ring the bell to summon a reindeer to do your dirty deeds!
Christmas Ornaments - Throw ornaments with knockback, every fourth throw is a deadly star with a Christmas greeting.

New playable character. 
Granny! That is it, it is a grandmother. But when it matters, Granny uses her primal instincts to survive =O

Updated menu and game lobby with some Christmas magic

When someone enter your lobby the game will receive a push notification. Thank you, "KnH ~ TouchMe" for the idea/tip/amazingAdvice

notes.title: Ehhh, another update! CHAT INCLUDED!!!
notes.notes:
-CHAT SYSTEM, we have now implemented a chat function! You can now chat with the people you are playing with.

-Achievement, a second achievement has been added! "So Classic!"

-And of course more bug fixes making the game more stable!

If you have problem in finding games we have a discord where people look for games: discord.gg/loopholeinteractive

notes.title: Update, again!

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
We have launched the game and are now fixing issues that have come to our attention!

We have made some fixes that will hopefully make the game run smoother!

Note: We are working on a system to make it easier for players to start a match!

notes.title: We are up and running!
notes.notes:
WOOOOOOHOOOO,

We are finally live and the game is now playable! It's been a very stressful day, with a lot of last minute tweaks and fixes. We hope you enjoy King of the Couch:  Zoovival!

If you encounter a bug or have suggestions, ideas, or questions. Join our discord and talk directly to us developers!

https://discord.gg/loopholeinteractive

After selecting your character and class, jump up to the green door with the sign that says Play over it. Once everyone is there you will be taken to the map selection screen.

Happy Zooviving!

notes.title: Only a day remains!
notes.notes:
We are on our toes excited for the launch of our first title! We hope that you are as well.

Our plans for the launch is to live stream the development team playing King of the Couch: Zoovival, host an AMA on reddit, and run around like headless chickens trying to make everything perfect!

If you lack people to play with, join our discord server (discord.gg/loopholeinteractive) to meet other Zoovivors looking to prove themselves in this natural selection simulator. Simply add each other as steam friends and baguette away!
